metric_definitions.additivity_warning: raw/overlapped H2D and compute-stream H2D wait overlap other categories; only attention + router projection + expert execution + exposed H2D + residual is an additive wall partition
metric_definitions.attention: CUDA event time around each self_attn module
metric_definitions.component_timing: intrusive profiles_at_bmax; exactly one Bmax wave per k and normalized by phase-token count
metric_definitions.compute_stream_h2d_wait: CUDA event time across compute-stream wait_event(copy_done); a direct H2D dependency wait, not total host synchronization
metric_definitions.decode_fetch_miss: an active non-Permanent Expert execution requiring one packed transient H2D fetch; expert_executions equals fetch misses plus Permanent hits
metric_definitions.expert_execution: CUDA event time from token index_select through Expert MLP and weighted index_add; not pure GEMM
metric_definitions.overlapped_h2d: intersection of Expert H2D intervals and expert-execution intervals
metric_definitions.performance_wall_time: uninstrumented runtime_at_bmax; exact for the 200-request makespan and every wave
metric_definitions.raw_h2d: sum of single-contiguous-buffer Expert H2D copy intervals
metric_definitions.residual_dense_dispatch_host_sync_idle: profile wall minus attention, router projection, expert execution, and exposed H2D; includes dense layers, unisolated dispatch, host work, explicit stream synchronize, and idle
metric_definitions.router_projection: CUDA event time around each MLP gate projection only; dispatch is not included
